tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm black on the site. In the app, the navigation ground. White in print.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Panels: the memory file, the app window, the install block. In the app, the workspace ground. 1.03:1 from ground on the site, so a pane always carries a rule.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Borders on panels and the fiction frame. In the app, borders. Never text.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside panels, header and footer borders, ledger rows on phone. In the app, raised surfaces. Never text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Human words: body, the claim, the brand word, the mark, the wordmark. 16.0:1 on ground and 15.6:1 on pane (site), 17.1:1 on the app ground, 20.1:1 in print.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary prose, nav links, ledger values in plain mode, lines carried over in the file. 7.5:1 on ground (site), 8.9:1 (app), 5.7:1 (print).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, file headers, rails, footer. 4.9:1 on ground and 4.7:1 on pane (site). Body size only, never below 12px. The app has no third grey: it uses text-2.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Site only. What the workspace recorded: ledger keys, file paths, counts, the active project, the open file, the agent's name in the chat, added memory lines, the focus ring, text selection. Never decorative. Never on the mark. Never in the app. 9.3:1 on ground, 5.9:1 in print.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill: selected text. 9.3:1 (site), 5.9:1 (print).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: App only. The primary action, links, selection, focus, the mark inside the app, the app icon. 14.5:1 on the app ground, 13.7:1 on the app pane. The print value is the app's own light-mode primary, 6.3:1 on white. On the site only inside an app screenshot, inside a rule frame.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text on a lime fill: the primary action label. 14.5:1 (app), 6.3:1 (print).

groups.name: The claim and the brand word

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The brand word. Use the path SVGs in production.

styles.name: claim
styles.sample: It knows you. Because you wrote it down.
styles.usage: The claim on the hero, the social card and under a lockup. Always text, never amber.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: What it saw, what it changed, what it left alone.

styles.name: file-speaks
styles.sample: The plan says: migrate the settings page first.
styles.usage: Only where the memory file speaks. Nowhere else.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Before the agent works, Vivary hands it a bounded capsule of the files that matter.
styles.usage: Body copy on the site. Geist Mono is the body face, not only the code face.

styles.name: ledger
styles.usage: Receipts and ledgers: key in text-3, value in text, a recorded value in amber.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Navigation and buttons. One primary call to action per page.

styles.name: app-body
styles.sample: Projects, conversations, files, approvals and Stop stay visible.
styles.usage: Inside the app, per its own rules. Not for the site.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The mark's corners and the app icon tile: one sixth of the tile side. 8 of 48 grid units, 170.67px at 1024.
